methods.candidate_workaround: Inspect and record the frozen-index top-level keys first, then select the declared proposal collection by exact schema field and fail explicitly if it is absent.
methods.failure_signature: The first read-only novelty probe assumed a proposals or entries array, while the inherited frozen index declares prior_proposals; PowerShell emitted a null-array error after producing a partial summary.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never let a later successful PowerShell expression mask an earlier schema-access error; inspect declared keys and check every native or runtime failure before credit.
methods.rollback: Give the partial probe zero novelty-audit credit, retain the null-array error, and rerun only the smallest key-first read-only query.
methods.scope_boundary: Owner-local schema discovery only; no scientific, authority, production, privacy-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
methods.title: Resolve frozen proposal collection from declared schema keys

methods.candidate_workaround: Accumulate PowerShell loop results in an explicit array and pipe that completed array to ConvertTo-Json after the loop.
methods.failure_signature: A novelty-search command piped directly from a foreach statement and PowerShell rejected the construction as an empty pipe element before any title comparison ran.
methods.recurrence_guard: PowerShell loops that feed serialization must assign to an explicit results array; parser failures receive no downstream evidence credit.
methods.rollback: Retain the parser failure, award zero novelty-search credit, and rerun only the corrected read-only loop.
methods.scope_boundary: Owner-local proposal-title inspection only; no scientific, authority, production, privacy-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
methods.title: Serialize PowerShell loop results after explicit accumulation

methods.candidate_workaround: Disable login-shell initialization for bounded probes, use an already responsive neutral working directory, address the target by absolute path, and separate existence, content, and compilation checks.
methods.failure_signature: Two simple inspection commands exceeded a ten-second wrapper deadline while launched with login-shell semantics and returned no filesystem evidence.
methods.recurrence_guard: Do not retry an identical timed-out login-shell inspection; change one causal dimension, split the probe, and preserve the original timeout as a failed witness.
methods.rollback: Award no inspection or compilation credit to either timeout and retain both wrapper expirations before using the bounded recovery.
methods.scope_boundary: Owner-local shell and filesystem inspection only; no scientific, authority, production, security-complete, accessibility-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
methods.title: Split login-shell startup from bounded filesystem and compiler probes

methods.candidate_workaround: Read the exact validate and summarize subcommand help, use validate --receipt and summarize --json-output plus --markdown-output, and avoid replaying already successful append-only mutations.
methods.failure_signature: Method Flow validate rejected an invented --output option after earlier record, witness, and state mutations had succeeded.
methods.recurrence_guard: Treat each Method Flow subcommand as a separate contract; check help before first use and resume only from the first failed step.
methods.rollback: Retain the parser failure, award no validation-receipt credit to it, and do not duplicate the preceding successful ledger events.
methods.scope_boundary: Owner-local Method Flow CLI contract only; no scientific, authority, production, security-complete, accessibility-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
methods.title: Interrogate Method Flow subcommand help before receipt emission

methods.candidate_workaround: Emit each exact collision and source, rename the new designs around their phase-specific acceptance semantics, and rerun the unchanged counted audit before materialization.
methods.failure_signature: The first counted expanded-portfolio audit found two exact normalized skill-name collisions and stopped before writing the x1 packet.
methods.recurrence_guard: No quota, prefix, or nearby purpose earns novelty credit when a normalized portfolio title collides exactly with inherited work.
methods.rollback: Write no x1 portfolio, retain the collision evidence, and change only the colliding declarations before rerunning the same audit.
methods.scope_boundary: Owner-local exact-title portfolio novelty only; no patent, scientific originality, authority, production, or independent-reproduction credit.
methods.title: Fail closed and rename exact inherited portfolio collisions

methods.candidate_workaround: Enumerate bounded prior-phase filenames first, select the actual skill-build-use and runner-build-use receipts, and treat an earlier missing-path error as failure even when later commands succeed.
methods.failure_signature: A prior-phase inspection attempted to read a nonexistent x2 skill-runner ledger while later commands in the same shell still returned partial evidence.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never infer an artifact filename from a conceptual label; discover the bounded file surface and stop compound-command success from masking an earlier error.
methods.rollback: Give the presumed-path read zero reuse credit, retain the missing-path witness, and use only the discovered exact filenames.
methods.scope_boundary: Read-only inherited artifact discovery only; no production, scientific, authority, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
methods.title: Discover prior artifact names before reading a presumed ledger
trigger_preconditions: later successful output after an earlier path error

methods.candidate_workaround: Set PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 for the bounded diagnostic, preserve UTF-8 source and artifacts, and rerun only the incomplete display.
methods.failure_signature: A Python diagnostic raised UnicodeEncodeError when the legacy Windows console codec encountered a Māori macron after returning only a partial task list.
methods.recurrence_guard: Any diagnostic expected to emit te reo Māori or other non-ASCII text must pin UTF-8 before Python starts; partial output earns no complete-review credit.
methods.rollback: Retain the encoding exception, award no complete-list credit, and do not transliterate or remove the source text.
methods.scope_boundary: Owner-local console encoding only; it establishes no Māori authority, cultural ratification, or broader accessibility conformance.
methods.title: Pin UTF-8 for console diagnostics containing Māori text

methods.candidate_workaround: Check x2 absence against the exact x1 Git object and check x1 Method Flow records as a preserved identified subset while allowing later append-only methods and witnesses.
methods.failure_signature: Two current-phase tests failed because x1-only absence and Method Flow cardinality were asserted against a live x2 working tree.
methods.recurrence_guard: Lifecycle tests must state whether their domain is an immutable commit or the current head; never infer historical contamination from legitimate additive later-phase files.
methods.rollback: Retain the two-test failure, award no current-suite credit, and change only the time-domain assertions before rerunning the same 26 tests.
methods.scope_boundary: Owner-local lifecycle test semantics only; no scientific, authority, production, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
methods.title: Bind x1 lifecycle assertions to the immutable x1 Git object
